defects.defect: Unfixed since round 1. Two manuscript numbers have no locus under tables/ and no entry in 01_numbers.json, so rule 1 cannot be satisfied for them and audit_numbers.py can never pass them. A2_T1 carries no pcr_*, kbet_* or exp_* column; both values live only in the upstream snapshot metrics_comprehensive_260905.csv. Both are correct - I reproduced them from that file merged to the 2,234-row key at round 1 (198 approaches with pcr_RNA_BATCH > 0.9999 from exactly 03_limma, 07_pycombat, 13_fsmvn, 21_harmonizr, 28_npn and 33_amdbnorm, 98.5% of them with kbet_acceptance_rate_RNA_BATCH < 0.1; mean exp_max over the 84 20_shambhala rows = 555,004.7). Separately the wording still misdescribes the statistic: 1,359.6 is the mean of the per-approach exp_median and 555,004.7 the mean of the per-approach exp_max, but the sentence says '20_shambhala returned a median of 1,359.6 and a maximum of 555,004.7'. A reader taking the median of exp_median gets 1,348.7 and the maximum of exp_max gets 1,873,593.6.
